title: One-step electrodeposition of W, Mo-Ni3S2/NF catalyst: an efficient hydrogen evolution electrode for alkaline media
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39355-39367
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07318A, Paper
Open Access

Wenyu Tan, Hanwei He
A self-supported tungsten (W), molybdenum (Mo)-Ni3S2/nickel foam (NF) hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) electrode was successfully fabricated on NF via constant current electrodeposition.
